content: To be joyful is the only virtue; to be miserable is the only sin.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Courage: The Joy of Living Dangerously
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

In Osho's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: If genuine peace is not dependent on future achievements, how can you celebrate being alive today?
